text:
```yaml
name: Maintenance Workflow

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *' # Run daily at 1 AM UTC

jobs:
  consolidate-agentic-workflows:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Update category in markdown files
        run: |
          sed -i 's/category: "q-a"/category: "agentic-workflows"/g' docs/audit-workflows.md
          sed -i 's/category: Audits/category: "agentic-workflows"/g' docs/portfolio-analyst.md

      - name: Recompile lock files
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add .
          git commit -m "Consolidate agentic workflow discussions to single category"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: main
```
